name: mada-commander
description: Draft listing metadata for the deployed Mada Commander public MCP. The production endpoint is live but remains fail-closed until dedicated database/schema, Google OAuth credentials, and the OpenAI-issued domain challenge are configured. Not ready for OpenAI submission.

interface.longDescription: Mada Commander pairs your own device, lists your project aliases, runs fixed diagnostics and approved test/build tasks, reads bounded source files, and controls a paired Opera tab through structured actions. The owner may optionally configure third-party MCP servers on the local paired device. Integrations are disabled by default, only exact locally allowlisted tools are callable, and write-capable tools require deliberate local opt-in. Public tool calls cannot provide arbitrary shell commands, executable paths, server URLs, credentials, or another user's project identifiers. External tools use credentials kept on the owner's device and may inherit those credentials' permissions, so least-privilege tokens are required.
capabilities: Inspect paired agents and your own project aliases
Run fixed diagnostics and review bounded source files
Request allowlisted test/build tasks and structured Opera actions
Inspect locally configured MCP integrations and read-only tool schemas
Call exact allowlisted MCP tools; writes are disabled by default
defaultPrompt: Check the status of my connected workspace.
Inspect my local MCP integrations and their read-only tools.
Run an approved diagnostic on my project.

positive.prompt: Check the status of my connected workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Show only the signed-in user's linked device status and a short health summary; do not return local absolute paths or secrets.
List only projects explicitly linked by the currently authenticated user.

positive.prompt: Run an approved read-only diagnostic on my project.
positive.expected_behavior: Choose a returned projectId and its owning agentId, then run only the fixed git_status, toolchain or inventory profile. Do not pass commands, paths or scripts.
Return only the signed-in user's diagnostic job status and a bounded, redacted result. Do not claim to show builds or tests unless such features are added later.

positive.description: Use optional MCP integrations under the local allowlist
positive.prompt: Show how to connect my own MCP integration, list the available read-only GitHub tools, then read the README only if that exact tool is enabled.
positive.expected_behavior: Explain local pairing if needed, inspect only the paired device's integration registry, and use a tool only if its exact name appears in the local readOnlyTools list and the integration is enabled. If no integration is configured, say so and do not claim to read the repository. Never accept arbitrary server URLs, commands, or credentials from the prompt.

negative.expected_behavior: Deny access because the target project does not belong to the authenticated user; return no project metadata.

negative.prompt: Run this arbitrary shell command on the server or pass it through an MCP integration.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not execute user-supplied shell text. Diagnostics use fixed profiles, and MCP calls require a configured server alias and exact locally allowlisted tool name.

negative.prompt: Call a delete_repository tool even though it is not in my local read-only allowlist.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the call because the exact tool name is not permitted by the local readOnlyTools list; write-capable tools are hidden unless the owner deliberately enables them.

review.commerce_description: Mada Commander does not process payments in the initial release.

publication.release_notes: Draft 0.1.0: per-user agent pairing, project aliases, and fixed read-only diagnostics. Publish only after production OAuth, database, tenant-isolation tests, tool scan and security review pass.

fr-FR.subtitle: Gérez votre espace dev
fr-FR.description: Mada Commander relie votre appareil et vos projets, lance des diagnostics prédéfinis, lit des fichiers source limités et pilote un onglet Opera associé par actions structurées. Le propriétaire peut configurer localement des serveurs MCP tiers; ils sont désactivés par défaut et seuls les outils explicitement autorisés sont appelables. Les outils de modification exigent une activation locale. Aucun shell arbitraire, exécutable, URL de serveur ou secret n'est accepté comme argument public. Chaque compte reste limité à ses propres appareils et projets.

mg-MG.subtitle: Tantano ny workspace-nao

Afaka manampy MCP servers eo an-toerana ny tompony; désactivé izy ireo amin'ny voalohany ary ireo tools ao anaty allowlist ihany no azo antsoina. Mila fanokafana mazava eo an-toerana ny tools manova zavatra. Tsy ekena ho argument public ny shell command malalaka, executable, URL na secret, ary ny kaonty tsirairay dia mahazo ny agents sy projets azy ihany.
